description_excerpt: Job Title: B2B Sales Specialist (Mandarin & English Speaker) Job Description The Advisor I, B2B Sales position interfaces with customers via inbound calls, outbound calls, or through the Internet for the purpose of selling basic products and services. This position is responsible for processing customer orders and sales, providing/receiving information, selling client products/service, as well as providing basic customer service support. • Achieve specific sales targets and maximizing sale opportunities on each and every call • Use script and/or probing techniques to determine customer needs…
